'''Oselle''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] during the [[Age of Legends]].

== Appearance ==
She had long black hair and seemingly fierce temper.

== History ==
She appears in the Seventh vision of Rand in the [[Glass columns|ter'angreal of Rhuidean]] standing in one of the rooms of the Hall of the Servants with half a dozen Aes Sedai, all female, planning over [[Callandor]] and the [[Dragon Banner|Banner of the Dragon]] based on the Foretelling of [[Deindre]] Sedai.

== Making the Eye of the World Edit ==
Oselle might have been part of the group of female Aes Sedai who created the [[Eye of the World]] with the help of young male Aes Sedai – [[Kodam]] and his fellows – who were not yet touched by the taint of saidin. Her death is not known, only that those who made the Eye died during the process. Jonai's memories indicate that Callandor was taken care of later, after the Banner of the Dragon. ''"The sword must wait."'' as it is said, and Callandor was set in the Stone of Tear also with the use of both saidin and saidar. The order of the events are not known.
